542a87166e434970.description: Job description STAGE - Développement d'une chaîne de modélisation de mise en forme textile à l'échelle mésoscopique F/H Stage 6 mois Etudiant Temps complet L'utilisation des matériaux composites dans l'aéronautique civile contribue à améliorer les performances des moteurs d'avions. Les composites à matrice céramique (CMC) ont d'excellentes propriétés thermomécaniques et thermiques qui garantissent leurs capacités de fonctionnement à des températures extrêmes. Leur utilisation dans les zones chaudes des moteurs permettrait d'augmenter significativement leur température d'utilisation, et donc, leur rendement. C'est dans ce contexte industriel que Safran CERAMICS développe de nouveaux matériaux CMC ainsi que les pièces associées. Certaines pièces en CMC ont une gamme de fabrication qui commence par une étape de tissage de plusieurs fils entre eux pour former un textile épais qui aura le rôle de renfort dans le futur composite. Ce textile est ensuite « mis en forme » dans un moule pour lui donner la forme de la pièce à venir. Finalement, une matrice est injectée pour former la pièce finale composée du couple fils/matrice, caractéristique d'un matériau composite. Le sujet de ce stage s'intéresse à la mise en forme du textile, avant l'injection de la matrice. La disposition du textile dans le moule joue un rôle crucial sur le produit fini en impactant directement : la qualité du matériau qui constitue la pièce, le dimensionnel de la pièce finie et l'homogénéité des propriétés matériaux dans l'ensemble de la pièce. Il faudra notamment s'assurer que le renfort fibreux rempli l'ensemble du moule. Ainsi que la capacité à prédire et à évaluer, via des outils numériques. La disposition du textile dans la pièce finale revêt donc un intérêt primordial dans la fabrication des pièces en CMC. L'étude des pièces en matériau CMC tissé 3D peut se faire à plusieurs échelles : macroscopique, mésoscopique ou microscopique. Le choix de l'échelle d'étude résulte souvent d'un compromis entre précision et temps de calcul. Ce stage s'intéressera à la modélisation de la mise en forme à l'échelle mésoscopique, l'échelle du fil. Plusieurs travaux préparatoires ont permis de mettre en place une chaîne de simulation servant à modéliser la mise en forme d'une préforme textile. L'objectif de ce stage est de continuer à l'amélioration de cette chaine numérique, en s'appuyant notamment sur l'identification de lois matériaux plus représentatives. Ce stage a pour force un balayage assez riche des métiers de la caractérisation, du calcul, de la synthèse matériau, voire de certains procédés de mise en oeuvre (tissage, moulage, notamment) et aussi le développement codes informatiques (Python, Python Abaqus) - Vous êtes en formation mécanique, modélisation (éléments finis), matériaux composites Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

5408123f441d6430.description: Job description Company Description Work with Us. Change the World. At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Conducts quality assurance reviews and oversees testing protocols to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements. Troubleshoots complex instrumentation and control system issues, implementing solutions that optimize system performance and reliability. Performance at this level requires developmental experience in a professional position. Qualifications **Required Qualifications:** Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Controls Engineering, or related engineering discipline Minimum 5-7 years of professional engineering experience in instrumentation and control systems design, implementation, or maintenance Demonstrated expertise in troubleshooting and optimizing complex ICT and instrumentation systems Strong proficiency in developing technical documentation, including design specifications, test reports, and system analyses Solid understanding of industry standards and regulatory requirements applicable to instrumentation and control systems Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple engineering assignments within budget and schedule constraints Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to junior engineers Excellent communication and collaboration skills with cross-functional teams Proficiency in engineering design tools and software relevant to instrumentation and controls **Preferred Qualifications:** Master's degree in Engineering or related field Professional Engineering (PE) license or Engineer in Training (EIT) certification Experience with design review processes and quality assurance protocols Familiarity with project management methodologies Knowledge of automation and control system platforms Experience in a regulated industry environment Additional Information At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. 545deb5a22cd679c.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن مؤسسة Elkhair Elwaffer، المتخصصة في قطاع النقل والخدمات اللوجستية بمدينة الرياض، عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى محاسب مالي. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على العمليات المالية والمحاسبية للشركة، والانضمام إلى فريق عمل متخصص. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إدارة الحسابات اليومية وتسجيل القيود المحاسبية ومراجعتها بدقة. إعداد القوائم المالية والتقارير المالية الشهرية والسنوية. متابعة الفوترة الإلكترونية والتأكد من الالتزام بالأنظمة السعودية المعمول بها. إجراء التسويات البنكية ومطابقة الحسابات بشكل دوري ومنتظم. إدارة حسابات العملاء والموردين ومتابعة المستحقات والمدفوعات. إعداد ومراجعة مسيرات الرواتب والعمولات والحوافز. مراقبة المصروفات التشغيلية وتحليل التكاليف والربحية. إعداد تقارير التدفقات النقدية والميزانيات التقديرية. متابعة الحسابات المالية للمشاريع والعقود المختلفة. تجهيز المستندات المطلوبة للمراجعة والتدقيق المالي. تقديم تقارير دورية للإدارة تتضمن الأداء المالي والتوصيات لتحسين الربحية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 3 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المحاسبة المالية. معرفة قوية بالمبادئ المحاسبية والمعايير المالية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المالية وتحليل البيانات. إتقان استخدام برامج المحاسبة والأنظمة المالية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق عمل متخصص في قطاع النقل والخدمات اللوجستية. الراتب يتراوح الراتب الشهري لهذا الدور بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي، وذلك حسب الخبرة والمؤهلات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم الشروط المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للانضمام إلى فريق Elkhair Elwaffer.

54a557ac30ae26d6.description: About the company Our client does AI match analysis for youth football. Fixed cameras at the pitch record every session. The models detect the events (passes, shots, goals), track the players, and read jersey numbers off low-res footage. Academies and parents get match stats, highlights and a per-player record. This is running today at a pilot academy in Dubai, on real matches, with paying pilots. They are now taking the same stack into a second industry. First customers are committed; details in conversation. This hire owns the platform across both: making the live sports models better, and building the new product on the same foundations. What you own • The shared CV platform, end to end: camera ingestion, detection and tracking, OCR, classification, and the reporting pipeline. It powers a product in production today and a second one launching. • From week one you ship to a live product: raising accuracy on the sports models with real users, while architecting the second industry's deployment on the same stack. • Architecture: model selection and training strategy, annotation and dataset operations, evaluation methodology, the on-prem/cloud split. • Shipping the new industry's first deployments, then hardening both products as one platform. • Technical leadership of the engineering team we build under you. Hiring process • Intro conversation: walk us through a CV system you built. Decisions, failures, numbers. • Technical deep-dive with senior engineers. • Case study on real footage: spec and prototype a detection task. • Founders' conversation, then offer. The whole process inside two weeks for the right person What we need to see • 5+ years building computer vision systems that ran in production. Deployed systems with users, not notebooks. • Strong Python and PyTorch, hands-on with modern detection and tracking (YOLO family, ByteTrack/DeepSORT or similar). • Video pipeline experience: RTSP/IP cameras, scheduled or streaming inference, ffmpeg-level fluency. • You have built datasets, run annotation operations, and measured models honestly against ground truth. • You have fine-tuned open-source models (detection, OCR of the PaddleOCR/TrOCR class) and taken the next step: replacing them with your own models trained on validated annotations, with a working annotation-review loop. • Fluent in the modern CV tooling ecosystem: Roboflow or equivalent for dataset and annotation operations, experiment tracking, model registries. • Ownership temperament: you take a vague operational goal and return a working system without waiting for a spec. Strong pluses • OCR, action recognition or pose estimation in production. • Sports, retail, industrial or facility camera-analytics background. • Edge deployment (Jetson or similar) and cost engineering of inference. • Camera and IoT literacy: sensor and lens selection, PoE networking, ONVIF/RTSP, NVRs, weatherproof housings. You can spec a site, not just a model. Full-time. Remote friendly: we hire the best person, not the nearest. Working hours overlapping the Gulf, with travel to Dubai for installation and milestone weeks. Competitive package plus options.

54de65bc610d2ad2.description: About Lucidya Lucidya is an AI-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth. Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalized experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value. Why This Role Matters Lucidya is entering a new phase of growth. As we continue to scale our commercial teams, expand our graduate hiring initiatives, and strengthen our presence across the Saudi talent market, the quality of the people we bring into the company will directly shape our future. This role is about much more than filling vacancies. As Talent Acquisition Lead, you'll play a key role in building the next generation of Lucidya talent. You'll help define how candidates experience our company, how future employees learn about our culture, and how we attract people who will raise the bar for everyone around them. You'll be the bridge between Lucidya and the talent market - representing our values, building relationships with universities, identifying high-potential graduates, and ensuring every candidate interaction reflects the kind of company we're striving to become. Success in this role means consistently attracting exceptional talent while creating a hiring experience that candidates remember for the right reasons. You'll help shape a culture where great people want to join, grow, and do the best work of their careers What You'll Do Build talent pipelines that fuel Lucidya's growth You'll partner closely with leaders across Sales, Customer Experience, Strategy & Performance, and other business functions to understand hiring needs and proactively build pipelines before roles become urgent. Rather than reacting to vacancies, you'll help the business stay ahead of its talent needs. Become the face of Lucidya for emerging talent You'll build strong partnerships with universities, student organizations, and graduate communities across Saudi Arabia. Whether you're presenting at a career fair, leading a campus event, or hosting students at Lucidya, you'll tell the story of who we are, what we believe in, and why ambitious graduates should build their careers with us. Design a graduate hiring experience that identifies future leaders You'll own recruitment for our graduate programs and assessment centers, creating structured processes that help us identify potential, not just experience. You'll continuously refine how we assess candidates to ensure we're selecting individuals who can thrive in a high-performance, high-growth environment. Create an exceptional candidate experience You'll ensure every candidate receives a professional, transparent, and engaging experience throughout the hiring process. You'll understand that every interaction shapes our employer brand, regardless of whether a candidate ultimately joins Lucidya. Help strengthen culture through hiring You'll partner with hiring managers to define what great talent looks like beyond technical skills. You'll help us consistently hire people who demonstrate curiosity, ownership, collaboration, learning agility, and a genuine desire to contribute to a positive culture. Improve how we hire and onboard You'll continuously look for opportunities to improve recruitment and onboarding processes. You'll use data, feedback, and candidate insights to identify bottlenecks, improve hiring quality, and create a smoother transition from candidate to employee. Measure what matters You'll track hiring performance through metrics such as time-to-hire, quality-of-hire, candidate satisfaction, pipeline health, and hiring manager satisfaction. Most importantly, you'll use those insights to drive better outcomes rather than simply report numbers. Who You Are You're passionate about talent and genuinely believe that hiring is one of the most important drivers of company culture and business success. You understand that every hire has the potential to strengthen or weaken a team's culture, and you take that responsibility seriously. You have 4-5 years of talent acquisition experience and have successfully managed end-to-end recruitment processes, ideally including graduate, early-career, or volume hiring programs. You're energized by meeting people and building relationships. Whether you're speaking with a student, a hiring manager, or a university dean, you're able to build trust quickly and represent Lucidya with confidence and authenticity. You're a strong storyteller and communicator. You can explain what makes Lucidya unique in a way that excites candidates and creates genuine interest in our mission. You're proactive and don't wait for hiring managers to tell you what they need. You anticipate challenges, identify opportunities, and take ownership of solving problems before they become urgent. You thrive in environments where priorities evolve quickly. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down - it motivates you to bring structure, clarity, and momentum. You're naturally curious and data-driven. You use metrics and feedback to improve your work, but you never lose sight of the human experience behind the numbers. You're highly organized and capable of managing multiple hiring initiatives, stakeholders, and timelines without losing attention to detail. You'll likely be a strong fit if you have: Saudi nationality (required) Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field 4-5 years of experience in talent acquisition or recruitment Experience with graduate hiring, assessment centers, internships, or early-career recruitment programs Experience managing full-cycle recruitment across multiple business functions Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills Experience working in startups, technology companies, or high-growth environments is a plus Familiarity with ATS platforms and recruitment technologies Experience using hiring data and recruitment metrics to drive decision-making What Success Looks Like in Your First 3-4 Months Established meaningful partnerships with key universities and graduate talent communities Successfully launched or improved graduate hiring initiatives Built stronger talent pipelines for commercial and business-critical roles Implemented improvements to candidate screening and assessment processes Delivered high-quality hires while maintaining an exceptional candidate experience Identified opportunities to improve onboarding and partnered with the People team to implement them Built strong credibility with hiring managers as a trusted talent partner What The Hiring Process Will Look Like Stage 1: Introductory Call Stage 2: Hiring Manager Interview Stage 3: Case Study Stage 4: Final Interview Stage 5: Offer
